desc:
AI workshops for your team, live online, teach practical skills on real work. Ecom Swift LLC prepares examples from your business, guides your people through hands-on tasks and leaves everyone with a handout and recording to keep.

## What is an AI team workshop?

An AI team workshop is a live, guided session where your staff practise using AI tools on their own tasks. People write replies, summarize notes, draft a checklist or tidy a document while a trainer guides them and answers questions in the moment.

It is a working session and not a lecture. By the end, each person has produced something real that they can use the next day.

## Why practice changes habits and slides do not

Watching a presentation feels productive, but the skill rarely sticks. People return to their desks and cannot remember the exact steps. A tool they only watched being used feels risky to try alone.

Hands-on practice changes this. When someone types a request, sees a weak answer, improves the request and sees a better answer, they learn how the tool behaves. That lesson belongs to them. Doing it beside colleagues also makes it normal, so shy or doubtful team members feel safe to ask questions.

## How a workshop improves team results

A workshop gives your whole team a shared baseline. Instead of one enthusiast who uses AI and ten who ignore it, everyone learns the same core skills and the same safe habits. Work that was written, summarized or sorted by hand can then be done faster and with more consistent quality.

Examples drawn from your business make the difference. When the exercise is a reply to a real kind of customer message, people see at once how the skill fits their job. A written handout and a recording extend the effect, because people can return to the steps whenever they need them. How much your team gains depends on how often they use the skills afterwards.

## What a great workshop includes

- Preparation based on your actual tasks, done before the session.
- Examples and exercises that look like your team's real work.
- Live practice for every attendee, not only demonstrations.
- Clear rules on safe use, including what never to paste into a tool.
- Time for questions that arise from live work.
- A handout summarizing the steps and example prompts.
- A recording of the session for people who missed it or want a refresher.
- A practice task to complete between sessions, in the fuller packages.
- A written team guide with exercises, in the largest package.
- A route for follow-up questions after the sessions end.

## How we run the workshops

Before the first session we ask about your team, their roles, the tools they have and the tasks they do most. We prepare examples and exercises from that. Sessions run online, so your team can join from the office or from home, and attendees need only a computer, an internet connection and access to a tool they already use.

The Basic package is a single session for a small group, with a handout. Standard has two sessions, a practice task between them, a recording of each session and a section on safe use. Premium has three longer sessions for a larger group, exercises built for your team, a written guide and question and answer follow-up. Add-ons include an extra session, a custom set of exercises and a short briefing for managers.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Bring real tasks, with private details removed.
- Ask every attendee to take part, not just watch.
- Tell us in advance what your team finds difficult.
- Complete the practice task between sessions.
- Use the handout and recording as a reference.

**Avoid:**
- Inviting a group so large that nobody gets time to practise.
- Bringing confidential customer files to the session.
- Expecting one session to change habits permanently.
- Skipping the safe use section because the team is in a hurry.
- Waiting weeks before using what was taught.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner who wants the whole team to use AI the same way, safely. It suits a department head whose staff have heard about AI but have no idea where to begin. It also suits a team where a few people have experimented and the rest feel left behind.

Attendees do not need experience. We start from the basics and adjust the pace to the group.

## What we need from you

A short note on your team, the tasks they do and the tools they use. A few anonymized examples of real work help us prepare. Please share a list of attendees and preferred times. We never ask for passwords. No account access is needed for a workshop, because everyone works in their own accounts during the session.
